The '''Noola system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Noola system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-5.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was home to<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Noolan]]|system=Noola [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Noolan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was introduced in "[[The New Rogues Gallery: Unsung Heroes of the Rebellion]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] source article written by [[Joe Littrell]] and published in the [[May]] [[1991]] [[Polyhedron 59|fifty-ninth issue]] of the ''[[Polyhedron]]'' magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''<ref name="Unsung Heroes of the Rebellion">{{PolyhedronCite|59|The New Rogues Gallery: Unsung Heroes of the Rebellion}}</ref> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>
